notes: Use Uber or Cabify (safer than street taxis); the Metropolitano bus is fast; Airport Express Lima costs 25 PEN. Stay in Miraflores, Barranco or San Isidro.
Summer in Lima runs from December to April: 25-28°C and sunny, with beaches (Punta Hermosa) open. February is the hottest month. May and October are transitional months.
Ceviche costs 40-70 PEN (lunch only, freshest then), menú del día (set lunch) 15, luxury 200+; tip 10%; cards are widely accepted, markets take cash. Don't drink tap water.
Larco and San Francisco are visited on tours or with guides; the Paracas trip leaves at 05:00 and makes a long day (the Cruz del Sur bus is comfortable); Huaca Pucllana is guided.
Safety: the centre is empty at night, don't stray outside Callao Monumental, and watch your phone on the street; Miraflores is safe.
Pisco sour, chicha morada (purple corn drink), lomo saltado, ají de gallina (creamy chicken stew), anticuchos, picarones; lucuma ice cream.

stops.name: Huaca Pucllana
stops.tips: A 1,500-year-old adobe pyramid in the middle of the city. Guided tour required; lit up in the evening.

stops.name: Parque Kennedy
stops.tips: Miraflores' park full of cats; stop at the picarones (fried sweet potato doughnuts) stand.

stops.name: Malecón de Miraflores
stops.tips: Clifftop coastal path; Parque del Amor (El Beso), paragliding (80 USD).

stops.name: La Mar Cebichería
stops.tips: Gastón Acurio's temple to ceviche. Lunch only; without a reservation expect a queue at 12:00. Try the leche de tigre.

stops.name: Malecón Gün Batımı Faro
stops.tips: Lighthouse and surfers; Pacific sunset (in summer).

backups.name: Punto Azul Miraflores
backups.tips: Good, cheap ceviche; expect a queue.

stops.name: Plaza de Armas Lima
stops.tips: UNESCO-listed centre; changing of the guard at the Government Palace at 12:00, the Cathedral (Pizarro's tomb) and the Town Hall.

stops.name: Convento de San Francisco
stops.tips: Catacombs with 25,000 skeletons and a Moorish-style library. Tour required; no photography.

stops.name: Casa de Aliaga
stops.tips: Home of the same family since 1535, the oldest private house in the Americas. Reservation needed.

stops.name: El Cordano
stops.tips: A 1905 tavern next to the palace; butifarra sandwich (pork sandwich) and pisco sour, a haunt of presidents.

stops.name: Barrio Chino Calle Capón
stops.tips: Chifa (Chinese-Peruvian) district; try Wa Lok.

backups.name: Museo del Banco Central
backups.tips: Gold and ceramics; free entry, an alternative to Aliaga.

backups.name: Chifa Wa Lok Barrio Chino
backups.tips: Lima's most famous chifa; arroz chaufa (fried rice).

stops.name: Museo Larco
stops.tips: Peru's best museum: 5,000-year-old gold, Moche ceramics, an erotic gallery, a bougainvillea garden and open storage.

stops.name: Museo Larco Café
stops.tips: Garden restaurant; lomo saltado (stir-fried beef), lovely setting.

stops.name: Barranco Puente de los Suspiros
stops.tips: The Bridge of Sighs; the Bajada de los Baños path leads down to the ocean, with street art along the way.

stops.name: MATE Museo Mario Testino
stops.tips: Museum of the fashion photographer, in a Barranco mansion.

stops.name: Ayahuasca Bar Barranco
stops.tips: Pisco cocktail bar in a restored mansion; go in the evening.

backups.name: Isolina Taberna Barranco
backups.tips: Criollo cooking in giant portions; reservation needed.

backups.name: Pedro de Osma Museum
backups.tips: Colonial art in a Barranco mansion.

stops.name: Paracas Ballestas Adaları Teknesi
stops.tips: 3.5 hours from Lima (tour departs 05:00, about 200 PEN) or by Cruz del Sur bus. The 'poor man's Galapagos': sea lions, Humboldt penguins and the Candelabro geoglyph.

stops.name: Paracas National Reserve
stops.tips: Where desert meets ocean: Playa Roja red beach, the Catedral rock and flamingos.

stops.name: Paracas Lagunillas Balık Lokantası
stops.tips: Fishing cove inside the reserve; ceviche and chicharrón de pescado (fried fish).

stops.name: El Chaco Paracas Sahili
stops.tips: Town beach; pisco sour, then 4 hours back.

backups.name: Huacachina Vahası Ica
backups.tips: Sand dunes and buggy rides (1 hour from Ica); pisco vineyard. An alternative to Chaco (return at night).

stops.name: Pachacamac
stops.tips: Pre-Inca pilgrimage centre (30 km south); Temple of the Sun and Acllahuasi, new museum. Go in the morning, before the haze.

stops.name: Huaca Huallamarca San Isidro
stops.tips: Restored adobe pyramid in the middle of a residential neighbourhood.

stops.name: El Olivar San Isidro
stops.tips: Park with an olive grove of 1,500-year-old trees; peaceful.

stops.name: Astrid y Gastón Casa Moreyra
stops.tips: The restaurant of Peru's culinary revolution; lunch menu, reservation needed (or choose cheaper Panchita).

stops.name: Bosque El Olivar Kafe & Sanat
stops.tips: Galleries in San Isidro.

backups.name: Panchita Miraflores
backups.tips: Acurio's criollo restaurant; anticuchos (beef heart skewers).

stops.name: Real Felipe Fortress
stops.tips: Spanish fortress from 1747; tour, harbour.

stops.name: Callao Monumental
stops.tips: Old port district with colourful murals; galleries (stay in the safe area).

stops.name: La Rana Verde La Punta
stops.tips: Yacht club restaurant; ceviche with sea views.

stops.name: Morro Solar Chorrillos
stops.tips: Cross on the Chorrillos hilltop; panorama of Lima bay. Take a taxi.

stops.name: Mercado de Surquillo
stops.tips: Local market; fruit (lucuma, chirimoya) and emoliente (warm herbal drink).

backups.name: Magic Water Circuit
backups.tips: Light-and-music park with 13 fountains; go in the evening. Guinness record holder.

backups.name: Sonia Chorrillos
backups.tips: A cevichería run by a fishing family.

days.theme: Ceviche morning and a gentle farewell

stops.name: Mercado de Surquillo No.1 Kahvaltı
stops.tips: Juice and tamal (steamed corn parcel) at a market stall.

stops.name: Parque del Amor Sabah
stops.tips: Statue of the kissing couple; mosaic bench.

stops.name: Al Toke Pez Surquillo
stops.tips: Ceviche and chicharrón combo at the counter; opens 11:30. Your farewell meal.

stops.name: Havalimanı Express Bus
stops.tips: Airport Express Lima from Miraflores takes 1 hour; farewell.

backups.name: Museo de Sitio Pucllana Kafe
backups.tips: Restaurant with a view of the pyramid.

backups.name: Indian Market Miraflores
backups.tips: Alpaca goods and handicraft souvenirs; on Petit Thouars.
